posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie is 8-1 at 1269.1 points-for and the African Bald Fraud slander has officially become a conspiracy theory nobody believes anymore.
posts.detail: League-best record, league-best points-for, and mjwithgoldhoops is making the 4-average-finish pedigree look like ancient history.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra has a 20-8 career record and a 1.5 average finish, and 2-7 at 929.86 points is the worst points total in the entire league — this isn't a slump, it's an obituary.
posts.detail: Back-to-back finalist pedigree meeting a league-worst scoring output is the single ugliest gap between résumé and reality in Busters Anonymous history.

posts.headline: Thicks' Klint's Clipboard is 7-2 but 1026.8 points-for is now dead last among every winning team in the league — the ring is doing all the talking because the scoreboard refuses to.
posts.detail: A title and a 5.5 average career finish should mean more than this; right now Thicks is surviving on matchups, not merit.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is 2-7 with a league-worst 934.22 points-for and a career 12th-place average finish — the irony of the name has officially become documentary footage.
posts.detail: Du Bois never saw this coming — the untalented tenth keeps living down to its own joke, week after week, with zero signs of a correction.

posts.headline: Sasinci is stuck at 4-5 and Big Head's title defense isn't flatlining anymore — it's been pronounced dead, with 1026.66 points-for barely keeping the lights on.
posts.detail: A ring and a 5.5 average finish bought Megamind patience, but this version of Sasinci is closer to quitting the league (again) than defending anything.
